summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Score Tracker app. All 10 requested test scenarios passed including player setup (add/remove/validation), 13-row score grid, dynamic totals, clear scores, end game, horizontal scroll, and sticky row labels.

issues: Score input cells of type=number accept negative values and decimals (e.g. -50 or 12.5) which may be undesirable for dart scoring. Consider adding min='0' and step='1' attributes to enforce non-negative integers.
Each empty cell shows '0' placeholder which can be visually noisy across a 13xN grid; placeholder color is already muted (neutral-800) so contrast is fine. Optional enhancement: blank placeholder.

action_items: (Optional) Add min='0' step='1' to grid score inputs to prevent negatives/decimals
(Optional) Consider blank placeholder instead of '0' in empty score cells
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean, well-structured, files under 200 lines each. Good use of data-testid throughout.
DRY minor: scores initialization logic duplicated in useState init and clearScores; could extract to a helper (createEmptyScores) - low priority.
useMemo properly used for totals computation.
No backend, so no API/env/validation concerns. Frontend correctly uses no backend calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only Score Tracker app. All core flows verified end-to-end via Playwright: setup with 10-player cap, remove players, start button disabled when no valid names, game screen renders correct columns and exact 13 row labels in order [Hourglass,20,DBL,19,TPL,18,61,17,1C,16,3C,15,Bulls eye], total calculation correct (sum of numeric inputs), clear scores resets inputs but retains player columns, end game returns to setup and resets to 1 input. Sticky left column confirmed (position:sticky), horizontal scroll confirmed (scrollWidth 2381 > clientWidth 1278 at 10 players). data-testid coverage is comprehensive.
